summary: Add opt-in sealed, indexed wire evidence segments with exact-byte export and transactional wire-row restore; hot persistence is unchanged

replay.detail: No graph replay. The wire-row restore primitive is not a replacement for logical backup restore or graph admission.

schema.detail: No database schema, claim kind or schema-version change. Segment format version one is a separate externally sealed binary archive.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or protected-witness selection changes in this reader-first primitive.

compatibility.detail: New opt-in wire archive reader/writer library API. No daemon default writes segments, no hot rows are removed, and the existing signature-reference writer activation is unchanged. Unknown segment versions fail closed.

downtime.detail: None; there is no live activation.

manual.detail: No production operation. Segment construction requires explicitly selected identities from a private offline source copy.

recovery.detail: Reverting does not affect the unchanged hot store. Retain any opt-in segments and their external seals; older binaries cannot consume them.
